business_summary: NIIT Limited engages in providing learning and knowledge solutions to individuals, enterprises, and various institutions in India and internationally. The company offers a variety of training programs, certifications, and solutions for career seekers and working professionals. The company also offers a program portfolio such as AI/ML, generative AI, data science, full-stack product engineering, 5g, cloud technologies, cybersecurity, and game development, along with programs in digital marketing, business development, banking, insurance and finance, and virtual relationship management for digital enterprises. In addition, the company provides NIIT Digital, a platform that enables technology-enabled learning experiences for corporate and individual learners; the Institute of Finance Banking & Insurance (IFBI), a provider of learning services, including career-launch and career-advancement programs for professionals in the BFSI sector; StackRoute, a digital transformation partner for corporates to build multi-skilled full-stack professionals in advanced technologies; RPS Consulting, a provider of training programs on digital technologies; Talent Pipeline as a Service (TPaaS), helps organizations in hiring skilled talent; iamneo, an AI-powered SaaS platform that provides automated coding labs, assessments, placement automation, and talent acquisition solutions to university students and professionals; and NIIT Sales & Service Excellence (SSE) that helps organizations in creating robust talent ecosystem. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Gurugram, India.
